meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速探查科学数据文件，找出缺失值、异常并生成探索报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到新数据集想先全面摸底,再决定如何处理与分析
copy.tagline_en: Inspect your scientific datasets for missing values, outliers, and key patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if in need of a quick data sanity check before deeper analysis

howto.what: 把科学数据文件路径交给 Claude，它会识别文件类型、做探索性检查（缺失值、异常值、质量与结构），并写出 markdown 报告。不认识的格式会先问你，不会硬猜。
howto.when: 当你给出一个受支持的科学数据文件路径（如 CSV/TSV/JSON、FASTA/FASTQ 等），或要求探索、总结、评估某份数据时触发。

say.text: 分析一下 reads.fastq 的结构和质量

say.note: 检查维度、缺失值、统计量与异常值

howto.what_en: Point Claude at a supported scientific data file: it detects the file type, runs exploratory checks such as missingness and outliers, and writes a markdown EDA report. Unknown formats stop and ask you first.
howto.when_en: Use when you give Claude a path to a supported scientific file (CSV/TSV/JSON, FASTA/FASTQ, image metadata, etc.), or ask it to explore, summarize, or assess a dataset.

say_en.text: Analyze the structure and quality of reads.fastq
say_en.note: Counts reads, lengths, GC content; writes a report

say_en.text: Make an EDA report for experiment_results.csv
say_en.note: Checks dimensions, missing values, stats, outliers

say_en.text: What format is this .xyz file, and what analysis fits it?
say_en.note: Looks up the reference, then suggests analyses
